videos.title: Some AI skills are making your agent worse.
videos.description:
If you make a new skill for every AI task, you might be making your agent worse.

Every skill you install leaves a name and a description that the model reads before you ask it anything. You pay for that whether the skill ever runs or not. Anthropic's own docs say it plainly: at startup, only the metadata from all Skills is pre-loaded, and you should only add context Claude doesn't already have.
